description: Permission Model filesystem over-grant via wildcard radix lookup
overview: A Node.js Permission Model filesystem over-grant lets a wildcard `--allow-fs-read` or `--allow-fs-write` rule match paths it should not. When the requested path is shorter than the prefix of a wildcard grant, the radix tree lookup stops comparing early and treats the path as a match, so for example `--allow-fs-read=/etc/passwd.*` also allows reading `/etc/passwd`. It requires the wildcard grant to sit directly under the root of the permission tree, such as when it is the only grant for that scope. This is a different root cause from CVE-2026-58043. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.
